text: dsh-devkit 是一款面向 DSH 的远程开发工具集插件，通过一个 MCP 客户端配置将 AI NetCafé 的开发端点接入 DSH。它提供 JSON 与 YAML 转换、JSON 校验、文本差异比较、正则测试、SQL 方言转换、二维码生成、时区和单位换算等操作，也能生成网页截图或 SQL 文件。用户可在任务中调用这些远程工具，适合需要可重复小型数据处理操作的 DSH 用户。使用时需连接 ainetcafe.com 服务；本地包只提供客户端配置。

dsh-devkit connects DSH to remote developer tools through an MCP client. It supports JSON and YAML conversion, validation, text diffing, regex tests, SQL conversion, QR codes, time and unit conversion, screenshots, and SQL generation. It needs access to ainetcafe.com.
想让 DSH 帮我把 JSON 转成 YAML。
I need a DSH tool to validate and format JSON.
Can I convert times between IANA time zones from a task?
dsh-devkit 的功能「远程开发工具」：通过配置的 MCP 客户端连接 AI NetCafé 开发端点，让 DSH 任务调用数据转换、校验和文本处理工具。工具请求经 streamable HTTP 发送到服务端。
dsh-devkit 将 MCP 请求发送到 ainetcafe.com 的开发端点；该服务端点在插件配置中固定为 /mcp/dev，使用这些远程工具需要网络连接。

dsh-netcafe-devkit README · dsh-devkit：> npm 上的包名是 `dsh-netcafe-devkit` —— `dsh-devkit` 已被他人占用。
> 仓库名不变,`dsh plugin add github:...` 的装法照旧。

JSON/YAML round-trip, JSON Schema validation, text diff, JWT decode, regex testing, SQL dialect transpiling, QR codes, timezone and unit conversion, page screenshots.

dsh-netcafe-devkit README · What & why：These are the operations an agent reaches for in the middle of something else. Doing them by prompting a model is slower, costs more and is not reproducible. `transpile_sql` runs a real parser (mysql, postgres, bigquery, snowflake, clickhouse, doris, starrocks), so syntax errors come back with line and column instead of a confident rewrite.

Every set ships `what_can_you_do` — describe a task in any language, get the exact tool plus a ready-to-run call.

dsh-netcafe-devkit README · What's in this pack：`—` in the price column means the tool is not metered per call (session/trial-gated instead). Failed calls are never charged. Check it yourself:

```sh
curl -s -X POST https://ainetcafe.com/mcp/dev -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}'
```

dsh-netcafe-devkit README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:mario03690/dsh-devkit
```

Thin config layer only (one `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` row, shipped as `cordis.patch.yml`) — no tool code runs on your machine. Built against the MCP client config shape of the dsh v0.1 developer preview; verified against the live endpoint on 2026-08-22.

dsh-netcafe-devkit README · Cost, quota, privacy：Mostly $0.001 per call and deterministic. Two exceptions that are not: `sql_from_description` ($0.01) calls a model, `screenshot_url` ($0.003) renders a page. Failed calls are not charged.

No signup for the free anonymous quota. Documents are processed in memory and not retained. The config URL carries `?s=dsh-dev` — a channel tag identifying the install path, not you.

dsh-netcafe-devkit README · Cost, quota, privacy：**Disclosure:** built and run by the team behind [ainetcafe.com](https://ainetcafe.com) — our own service, free tier plus paid usage. Full bundle (everything at once): [dsh-netcafe](https://github.com/mario03690/dsh-netcafe). MIT.

dsh-netcafe-devkit README · Compatibility & permissions (at a glance)：| Signal | This plugin |
| --- | --- |
| **Runtime** | dsh v0.1 developer preview (Cordis v4). Touches only the MCP client config shape — the narrowest surface available. Verified against a live endpoint on 2026-08-22. |
| **What runs locally** | Nothing. Ships one `cordis.patch.yml` row; there is no tool code, no build step and no lifecycle script in this package. |
| **Filesystem access** | None. |
| **Shell / process access** | None. |
| **Network access** | Outbound HTTPS to `ainetcafe.com` only, from the MCP client that dsh already ships. |
| **Credentials** | None required for the free tier. An optional AllRouter key, if you supply one, is sent by dsh as a request header and is never stored by us. |
| **Data retention** | Documents and prompts are processed in memory and not retained. |
| **Dependencies** | One peer dependency: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` (ships with dsh). |
| **License** | MIT (see `LICENSE`). |
| **Publisher** | The team that runs [ainetcafe.com](https://ainetcafe.com). Issues get a same-day reply. |
dsh-netcafe-devkit README · Compatibility & permissions (at a glance)：> A directory listing is not a security review. Read `cordis.patch.yml` — it is short enough to read in full in under a minute.
